svg.text: Derive with reorganize=True — Filter & Thematic Aggregation
Each catalog line is one ArticleMeta from the compiled wiki.
Keys field lets a topic naming a specific setting or endpoint
match the article that documents it.
Batch full → seal it, start a new one
Phase 2 — Resolve Sources & Copy to derived/<slug>/
Phase 3 — Reorganize (build entity index → resolve entities → plan aggregation)
For each extraction, aggregate into EntityIndex:
entities: {name → [EntityOccurrence(source, type, context)]} — frequency across docs
Drop names >60 chars or matching enumeration patterns (e.g. "list of …")
Prompt: "identify groups referring to the same entity"
Merge across batches; build CanonicalMapping (alias → canonical reverse lookup)
• categories: concept · decision · project · reference · guide · person
LLM per raw doc → structured JSON
"Route this extraction into one or more of the planned thematic articles"
"Prefer merging into planned articles over creating new ones"
"Create new only if the extraction covers a theme not in the plan"
No classify cache (plan varies per run) · May route 1 extraction → N articles
Multiple extractions merge into the same thematic article,
producing cross-cutting wiki entries instead of per-chapter ones.
Planned article title/type used when creating path for first time
wiki/ contains 3–15 cross-cutting thematic articles instead of per-document chapters
Filter (RECALL) → Resolve & Copy → Reorganize (entity index → canonicalize → plan) → Compile (extract → topical classify → write → index)
